name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
objectiveText: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Chef Jessen in Southshore. Turtle Meat  ( 10 ) Soothing Spices  ( 1 )

comments.body:
LVL 34, 2500 XP
Turtles spawn on the river E of Southshore. They spawn from next to the town to all the way up past Tarren Mill.

I got meat off of lvl 30 and 31 turtles. I would estimate that I killed about 25 to get 10 meat.

The soothing spices can be purchased from the trade supplier in the big building N of the inn and across the street (last bldg before griffons)
replies: Go to thousand needles for turtles, lots more there to farm and around the same drop rate. Wetlands boat to Theramore then south one zone to thousand needles.
Had to kill about 50 in Hillsbrad Foothills to get my 10 turtle meat, so put the coffee ketle on!

comments.body: You can get Soothing Spices in Southshore. 48, 55 from Micha Yance
replies: The soothing spices can be purchased from the trade supplier in the big building N of the inn and across the street (last bldg before griffons)

comments.body:
My advice.... if you plan to do this quest, what you do:

At lvl 30 there is a quest over in Thousand Needles at the Goblin/Gnome race track to kill Turtles for their shells. They drop the SAME Turtle Meat as the ones near SS, and they drop the Hardened Turtle Shells or whatever you have to get for the quest, VERY RARELY. You need 8 or 9 of them.

So go do the shells quest, by the time you're done you can fly over to SS and turn in the turtle meat to get double bonus for fighting those STUPID ass turtles for SO LONG!

--BobTheSmall
1500 XP at level 38, when the quest is green.

This quest is for the Alliance faction only.

Horde players will have to follow this quest:
https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=7321

2500 exp at level 29, when the quest is yellow.

The lake location described below is definitely the ideal place for this, if a bit far to walk to. Drop rate is about the same as murloc quest drops, which is to say not very high. These are easy kills though, auto-attack and AFK (which is what I did).
You can get Soothing Spices in Southshore. [b]48, 55[/b] from [b]Micha Yance[/b]

As a lvl 32 Mage with 3 points in Elemental Precision the level 31 turtles were resisting a LOT of my spells.  Not sure if they have resistance to frost spells...  Is there a way to find that out?  Seems like my fire and arcane spells are not resisted nearly as much.
replies: I used Beast Lore on them, all have at least 75 Frost Resistance.

If you're a Frostie, you'd better skip this or you'll be in a rotten mood for some time. Presumable you haven't leveled up your fire spells but even with a fire wand, they resist far more than anything else at that level and the drop rate is pretty silly.

comments.body: Soothing Turtle Bisque (Quest) tloc 69,13 (The whole river up and down you can find the turtles)

replies: Before heading to the Snapjaw's, check with the Trade Goods seller, Micha Yance at 48,55 in the 2 floor building North of the Inn & across the street. He sells the "Soothing Spices" (when instock). (Exit the Inn and make a right. It is the last building on the left just before the Gryphon's)

comments.body: if you swim up river all the way to western plaguelands the drop rate improves as you go. i was getting 2 or 3 pieces at a time when they dropped. plus you can skirt around the edge and get the flight path in western plaguelands without having to face the high level monsters

Lordamere Lake on the north edge of Dalaran (Big Pink Dome thing on the West Edge of Alterac Mtns.) is a much better place to find turtles. There are TONS of them all along the south and west shores of this lake.

very easy quest, "head up past Dalaran to Lake Lordamere" coords 23,45.  I found a low drop rate from the turtles on the shore (and along the river for that matter), HOWEVER a 100% drop rate from the turtles [u]under the water[/u], infact they were dropping 2-3 pieces of meat each and this was from both lvl 30 & 31 turtles.  So take a swim, I even found a bunch of Lake Frenzy to cook as well.  Then to complete the quest you will need Soothing Spices, which you can purchase from trade vender Micha Yance in Southshore, he's inside the house closest to the gryphons @ 49,55.

Can be bought from a vendor in Southshore.

Around 48,56. One of the shops close to the griffon rider.

I killed every turtle up the river and got [b]1[/b] friggin turtle meat (from 25-30 turtles).

I then went to the lake, as it says in the quest, and killed maybe 10 more turtles from the shore and got 1 more meat.  I was still in the Dalaran subzone as I did this.

I then went INTO the lake, so that I was in the actual Lordameare Lake subzone, and after that almost every turtle dropped meat, and some 2.  I only had to kill about 8 more turtles.

So I think maybe the drop rate is boosted if you're in the actual lake subzone.
